Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama.docker_hint: > Container environment detected. If Base Url is empty, `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` is used by default.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.openai:
##### OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [OpenAI Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`; enter another endpoint when using a compatible service
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
> Accessing the official service may require a network proxy in some regions

Translation.llm_provider_tips.moonshot:
##### Kimi / Moonshot Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [Kimi Open Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/models?aff=MoneyPrinterTurbo)

Why recommended:
- **Fits the video creation workflow**: helps generate scripts, extract stock-footage search keywords, and improve final footage relevance
- **Strong long-context capability**: useful for longer topics, batch scripts, and complex prompts
- **Flexible billing**: pay only for what you use, with transparent costs

Translation.llm_provider_tips.cloudflare:
##### Cloudflare AI Gateway Configuration
- **API Key**: create a token in the [Cloudflare dashboard]({api_key_url}) with `AI Gateway - Read`, `AI Gateway - Edit`, and `Workers AI - Read` permissions
- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID
- **Gateway ID**: defaults to `{default_gateway_id}`; you can also enter an existing Gateway ID
- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway
Translation.llm_provider_tips.minimax:
##### MiniMax Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/) or [international platform](https://platform.minimax.io/)
- **Base Url**: use `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1` for China or `{default_base_url}` for international access (default)
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account

Make sure the API Key and Base Url belong to the same platform, or authentication may fail.

Translation.Documentary SEO Title Variants Help: Other title options you can A/B test instead of the main title above.
Translation.Documentary SEO Keywords Help: Broader keywords for the platform's tags/keywords field (not on-screen hashtags).
Translation.Documentary Video Source Help: Choose between free stock footage or AI-generated video clips (real cost per video, requires a configured fal.ai API key).
Translation.Documentary AI Video Not Configured: AI video generation is not configured. Add a fal.ai API key in config.toml to enable this option.
Translation.Documentary AI Video Cost Disclaimer: This is an estimate based on the configured model tier, not a final bill -- the real charge is billed to your fal.ai account.
Translation.Documentary AI Video Cost Confirm: I understand the estimated cost and want to proceed.
Translation.Documentary AI Video Clips Generated Suf: clip(s) were already generated (and billed) before this failure, but the documentary could not be completed.
Translation.Documentary AI Video Retry Guidance: You can switch Video Source to Stock Footage above and click Generate Documentary again.
Translation.Documentary AI Video Extended Pacing War: Extended pacing's scenes (30s each) are much longer than a single AI clip (max 10s) can cover -- expect noticeably more repeated frames per scene than with Stock Footage or shorter pacing.
Translation.Documentary Edit Script Help: Edit the narration text per scene, then regenerate audio and video. The visuals (stock footage or AI clips) are NOT regenerated -- only the voiceover, timing, SEO, and final render.
Translation.Documentary Edit Script Large Change War: Best for small wording fixes. Large content changes are not recommended: if the new narration's length differs a lot from the original, the existing footage may no longer match well (clips could repeat or get cut short).
Translation.Documentary Edit Script Regenerating: Regenerating audio and video from your edited script...
Translation.Documentary Edit Script Success: Script updated -- audio and video regenerated successfully.
Translation.Documentary Edit Script Failed: Failed to regenerate from the edited script
Translation.Documentary Custom Tags Help: Your own organizational tags (like a playlist), for finding related videos later -- not SEO hashtags/keywords, no effect on how the video is discovered on any platform.
Translation.Documentary History No Match For Tags: No productions match the selected tags.
Translation.Documentary System Prompt Help: Additional style/persona guidance, added alongside the narration writer's base instructions (shown as a placeholder below) -- the base instructions always stay in effect and cannot be removed.
Translation.Documentary Custom Requirements Help: Extra instructions for this narration, added on top of the automatic growth/quality requirements (they are not replaced).
